motion.name: landing-control
motion.purpose: Subtle hover state changes for landing actions.

components.name: Hero Primary Action
components.description: Filled action on the blue homepage hero.
components.css: .ds-hero-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0.7rem 1rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; color: #243d4a; font: 600 0.92rem/1.3 'Steady Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-hero-primary:hover { background: #e5f0f3; } .ds-hero-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #fff; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Hero Secondary Action
components.description: Outlined secondary action linking to the homepage process section.
components.css: .ds-hero-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0.7rem 1rem; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.72); border-radius: 12px; background: transparent; color: #fff; font: 600 0.92rem/1.3 'Steady Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-hero-secondary:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.12); } .ds-hero-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #fff; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Landing Navigation
components.description: Brand, process anchor, and check-in action on the framed blue hero.
components.html: Steady-AhhHow it worksStart a check-in
components.css: .ds-landing-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; padding: 1rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 18px 18px 0 0; background: #47718a; color: #fff; font: 400 0.9rem/1.4 'Steady Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-landing-nav a { color: #e5f0f3; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-landing-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #fff; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Hero Image Placeholder
components.description: A temporary, clearly labeled portrait area occupying the right side of the framed blue hero.
components.html: Person-led image placeholder
components.css: .ds-hero-image-placeholder { display: grid; min-height: 19rem; place-items: center; padding: 1.5rem; border: 1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,.62); border-radius: 14px; background: rgba(229,240,243,.11); color: rgba(255,255,255,.88); text-align: center; }

components.name: Synthetic Field Record
components.description: One light sheet below the hero demonstrates a synthetic check-in, observed evidence, and optional reflection.
components.html:
Synthetic example

Thursday, 7:40 pm

Feeling: Drained · Energy: 2 / 5

Observed

Several recent check-ins mention feeling drained after agreeing to plans.

Reflection

Notice whether you say yes when you would rather rest.
components.css: .ds-field-record { padding: 1.5rem; border-radius: 14px; background: #fbfaf5; color: #253b46; font: 400 0.9rem/1.5 'Steady Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field-record small { color: #50636b; } .ds-field-record h2 { margin: 1rem 0 .5rem; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-field-record hr { margin: 1rem 0; border: 0; border-top: 1px solid #cbd7d8; } .ds-field-record strong { display: block; margin-top: .65rem; color: #365d70; font-size: .72rem; letter-spacing: .04em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-field-record p { margin: .2rem 0 0; }

components.name: Process Row
components.description: An airy explanatory row pairs a step title with plain-language detail, without repeating sample data.
components.html:
Pattern Recognition

Simple rules look for recurring situations and changes in energy.
components.css: .ds-process-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(13rem,.55fr) minmax(0,1fr); gap: 3rem; align-items: baseline; padding: 1.35rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #cbd7d8; color: #253b46; font: 400 .95rem/1.65 'Steady Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-process-row h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-process-row p { max-width: 60ch; margin: 0; color: #50636b; } @media (max-width: 650px) { .ds-process-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: .5rem; } }

narrative.overview: The homepage follows the reference’s human-centered composition: an open blue frame, restrained navigation, and a large portrait area balanced by spacious editorial copy. A person-led image gives the first screen a warm, human focus. A clearly synthetic paper record appears below the hero to show how a check-in can lead to evidence and optional reflection. The current portrait area is an intentional placeholder. This direction applies to the public landing page. The check-in, dashboard, insights, and settings screens retain their existing application styling. Product commitments remain calm first, evidence before explanation, user choice, and privacy.
keyCharacteristics: A thin, rounded blue frame around the opening scene.
A portrait-led hero with open space for readable copy.
Check-in evidence presented after the hero, separate from the welcome.
Plain language and visible user choice.

rules.name: The Evidence Contrast Rule
rules.body: Keep the record sheet light against the blue hero so the sample remains easy to scan and its labels remain legible.

rules.name: The Plain Voice Rule
rules.body: Let concise, direct wording carry warmth; avoid clinical certainty and performative intimacy.

dos: Do keep the check-in route and ‘See how it works’ action easy to find.
Do distinguish recorded feelings, repeated evidence, and optional reflection.
Do keep privacy controls and the non-diagnostic boundary visible in plain language.
Do preserve comfortable reading widths, keyboard focus, and reduced-motion support.
donts: Don't present a pattern as a diagnosis or a certainty.
Don't use urgency, streaks, guilt, or pressure to drive check-ins.
Don't invent social proof, expert endorsement, or unsupported product claims.
Don't crowd the hero with decorative wellness imagery or competing calls to action.
